name: rimsynapse-mcp
description: GitHub project management plus a local RimWorld build/launch/log harness for the RimSynapse mod ecosystem.
long_description: Provides two families of tools. GitHub tools manage issues, project boards, wikis and testing plans across the RimSynapse organization. RimWorld tools build the mods in dependency order, deploy them into the game's Mods folder, launch RimWorld for automated smoke or TestRunner runs, and parse Player.log into classified errors, Harmony patch failures, missing dependencies and [SYNAPSE-TEST] results.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a GitHub issue in a RimSynapse repository

tools.name: add_project_item
tools.description: Add an issue to the project board

tools.name: get_project_items
tools.description: List items on the project board

tools.name: update_project_item_status
tools.description: Move a project item to a different status column

tools.name: cleanup_project_board
tools.description: Tidy up stale entries on the project board

tools.name: update_project_item_iteration
tools.description: Set the iteration field on a project item

tools.name: get_file_content
tools.description: Read a file from a repository

tools.name: create_or_update_file
tools.description: Create or update a file in a repository

tools.name: create_testing_plan_issues
tools.description: Attach a testing plan to an issue and mark it as Testing

tools.name: sync_repo_wiki
tools.description: Push Learning markdown to a repository wiki

tools.name: build_mods
tools.description: Build RimSynapse mods with dotnet in dependency order

tools.name: deploy_mods
tools.description: Symlink the mods into the RimWorld Mods folder

tools.name: launch_rimworld
tools.description: Launch RimWorld for a smoke or TestRunner run and stop it afterwards

tools.name: read_player_log
tools.description: Parse and classify RimWorld's Player.log since the last launch

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Build, launch with the TestRunner, and parse the log in one call

github_token.title: GitHub Token
github_token.description: Personal access token with 'repo' scope. Required for the GitHub issue, project and wiki tools; the RimWorld build/launch tools work without it.

rimsynapse_root.title: RimSynapse Workspace
rimsynapse_root.description: Folder containing the RimSynapse mod repos and the _harness scripts (the folder with Core/, Factions/, _harness/).
